originality.rationale: The published full texts inspected provide either single-index marginal valuations, index/divisibility densities, fixed-suffix residue-image closures, or joint laws for different coefficient families. The known binomial recurrence and the easy signed-jump corollary are acknowledged. None states or parametrically implies the all-odd-prime consecutive-index five-state joint polynomial and exact covariance sign phase; broad implicit historical transfer formulas remain a residual risk.
residual_risks: Some earlier digital-transducer literature could encode the same joint pair under a non-obvious equivalent formalism; historical uniqueness is not independently certified.

The 2026 marginal generating function and classical coefficient recurrence make some consequences short; the originality claim is primarily the coupled full joint transfer and sharp covariance phase, not the known ingredients.

value.rationale: The natural index-local prime divisibility fluctuations of central binomial coefficients are resolved as an exact bivariate distribution for every odd prime and complete prime-power index block. In addition to all joint multiplicities, a sharp and unusual negative-to-positive ternary covariance transition and exact high-depth correlation rate follow. A one-index marginal law cannot reconstruct the ordered two-index statistics, so this supplies mathematically motivated structure beyond a routine restatement.
